Detailed scenes and short, calming phrases, for ages 8 to 12

The Frequency Buddies Books, Book 4: Color and Calm with Tidbit and Sugarfoot.
By Christian. Independently published.

Pictures © 2026 Christian. First print edition, October 2026. Printed on demand, with a black-and-white interior.

The back of every picture is blank, so markers will not soak through to the next one. Slide a sheet of paper under the page you are coloring.

Free online, always. The characters live at spreadloveandacceptance.com, where everything is free to read and use, with no account and no paid version. This print book is optional. You may copy pages for personal use and for non-commercial teaching, with credit to “spreadloveandacceptance.com.”

How it was made. The pictures were drawn by code that was written with an AI tool, in the same style as the characters on the site. The phrases were drafted with an AI writing tool.

Set in Fraunces and Andika (SIL Open Font License).

Breathe in slowly. Breathe out longer.
Smell the flower. Blow the candle.
It is okay to need a minute.
Fast and slow can still walk together.
Say what you need, kindly and plainly.
Feelings are weather. They pass.
One job each makes the basket light.
Room first, then a hug.
You can say sorry and make it right.
A pause is better with a time to come back.
Notice your body. What is it telling you?
Big feelings are allowed.
Static is just loud feelings looking for a friend.
Ask first. Then help.
Take turns. Then take another.
Different is okay.
You can start again.
Kind words are free.
Slow is a speed too.
Your calm can keep someone company.
Say it so it lands.
Hungry, tired and loud? Snack and rest first.
Everyone has a rung on the ladder today.
Let the storm pass.
Listen with your whole face.
Two hearts can share one.
It is okay to change your mind.
Thank someone today.
Goodnight, worries.
Look up. The sky is big.
You belong here.
Spread love and acceptance.

Thank you for coloring!

Draw your own friend on the back of this page, or on any blank back.
